title: Recover ordinary task sync across divergent task and memory profiles
outcome: Resolve differing parent profile capabilities without leaving a merge that cannot be resumed.
acceptance: A CLI regression creates divergent task-only and task-and-memory data tips and verifies a supported resolution or a refusal before a merge starts. Both tips and task and memory data remain intact.
The refusal or completed resolution gives the operator the supported next action, with no false success receipt.
